notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
We are currently working on our first major update to Wicked West. It will see us update a variety of content within the game including:
[list]
[*]Updates to user interface
[*]Enemy spawning will be adjusted into Waves
[*]Three new Bosses will be added
[*]Upgrades adjusted to unlock at certain waves
[*]Experience Levels will lead to score boosts
[/list]

Plus other content will be included in the new update. More details and a full changelog to come when the update is ready to go live in February.
